name: Tweaks
subtitle: Tweaked apps and on-device tweak injectors
description: Tweaked builds of YouTube, music, X, Instagram, Messenger, Discord and Twitch apps, plus the tools that inject tweaks into an app on the device. Every entry is published installable by the tweak project itself — OmniSource tracks and re-verifies that release, it does not patch binaries.

apps.name: BHTwitter
apps.subtitle: X (Twitter) with no ads, downloads and the chronological timeline
apps.localizedDescription: BHTwitter is a long-running tweak for X (formerly Twitter), published as a ready-to-sideload IPA. It hides promoted posts and ads, restores the chronological timeline as the default, and lets you download videos, GIFs and images straight from a post. It also adds Face ID / Touch ID app lock, custom fonts, undo posting, inline translation, direct saving of profile pictures and headers, confirmation prompts for likes and reposts, and switches for hiding the tabs and UI elements you never use.

apps.subtitle: RootHide bootstrap for iOS 15 – 17
apps.localizedDescription: Bootstrap is roothide's semi-jailbreak bootstrap for iOS and iPadOS 15.0 through 17.0 on A8 to A17 Pro and M1/M2 devices. Instead of jailbreaking the whole system it builds a hidden environment that boots Sileo, Zebra and rootless tweaks while App Store apps stay untouched — so banking, streaming and game apps that refuse to run on a jailbroken device keep working. Apps are patched one at a time when you want tweaks inside them, and the whole environment can be removed again.

apps.versionDescription:
Twitter 2.2 | NeoFreeBird-2.2-Twitter-11.35-noFixTwitterLogin

NeoFreeBird is a modified Twitter app with branding reverts, BHTwitter and other QoL modifications. It also seems to be faster compared to the official Twitter app, which says something.

### Change log:

**Twitter, version 11.35:**
- Updated the Twitter build to 11.35

**NeoFreeBird, version 2.2:**
- Fixed log in issues using new sign in flow (you can only sign in to one account at once but better than nothing) [#78]
- Localized the Post > Tweet replacer
- Improved the Open in Twitter extension
- Minor bug fixes and other minor improvements

There are two versions, one with FixTwitterLogin dylib (standard) and one without. Try the regular one first, and if you’re unable to install it, try the one without. Both have the new sign in flow, the one with FixTwitterLogin just has the same dylib injected as 2.1 rev 2 to trick Attestation in some cases, allowing some users to sign in to multiple accounts. It works for some and not for others.

If you are already signed in to two accounts, you will still stay signed in to them, you just can't add more.

# Changelog

## 4.3 Build 253 (2026-04-23) [EN]

Fixed an assertion crash related to MachOKit.

## 4.3 Build 246 (2026-04-16)

修复二次注入时可能误选已注入动态库作为目标 Mach-O 的问题。

### 修复

- 注入目标选取：修复追加注入时，上次注入的动态库可能被误选为注入目标的问题。  
  新增三层防御：从注入前备份读取原始 Load Commands 以还原真实依赖链；枚举阶段跳过 `.troll-fools.bak` 备份文件；通过备份差分精确识别并排除已注入的动态库。

------

## 4.3 Build 246 (2026-04-16) [EN]

Fixed an issue where re-injection could incorrectly select a previously-injected dylib as the target Mach-O.

### Fixed

- Target selection: Fixed re-injection potentially picking a previously-injected dylib as the injection target.  
  Added three-layer defense: read original load commands from pre-injection backup to restore the true dependency chain; skip `.troll-fools.bak` backup files during enumeration; use backup-diff to precisely identify and exclude previously-injected dylibs.

------

## 4.3 (2026-04-13)

本次版本聚焦于“动态加载框架兼容性”和“页面说明可理解性”，并包含插件管理流程调整与资源清理。

### 修复

- 注入兼容性：修复部分 Unity/运行时 `dlopen` 场景下无法命中可注入目标的问题。  
  当主程序静态链接交集为空时，改为回退扫描 `Frameworks/` 中可用 Mach-O（含一级目录下 `.dylib`）。
- 插件管理：调整“移除插件”流程，区分已启用与已禁用插件：  
  已启用插件执行卸载；已禁用插件执行标记清理，降低批量处理风险。

### 新增

- 高级选项：新增“启用兼容模式回退”开关（默认开启），可控制是否在无静态链接命中时启用回退候选。
- 结果页提示：当本次注入通过兼容模式完成时，在“已完成”下方显示额外提示。

### 优化

- 候选筛选：回退候选新增过滤，排除 `libswift*` 与已忽略注入相关动态库/框架，并统一大小写处理。
- 诊断日志：增强 Mach-O 扫描日志，输出候选数量、文件大小、加密/不可读统计与最终选择结果，便于定位“无可用目标”问题。
- 设置说明：优化高级选项页面结构与说明文案，减少非技术用户理解成本。
- 广告与资源：移除内置广告位 `Letterpress` 及相关本地化词条/图标资源；更新营销图素材。

### 本地化

- 更新 `en/zh-Hans/it/vi` 词条，补充兼容模式与设置说明相关文案，并清理移除条目对应文案。

------

## 4.3 (2026-04-13) [EN]

This release focuses on dynamic-framework injection compatibility and clearer user guidance, plus plugin-management flow adjustments and resource cleanup.

### Fixed

- Injection compatibility: Fixed cases (notably Unity/runtime `dlopen` flows) where no injectable target could be selected.  
  When the static-link intersection is empty, TrollFools now falls back to scanning eligible Mach-O files under `Frameworks/` (including top-level `.dylib`).
- Plugin management: Updated plugin removal flow to handle enabled vs disabled plugins separately:  
  enabled plugins are ejected, while disabled plugins are cleaned via desist/marker path handling.

### Added

- Advanced Settings: Added **Enable Compatibility Fallback** (default ON) to control fallback candidate behavior when no static-link match is found.
- Result-page notice: Added a subtitle under **Completed** when injection succeeds through compatibility fallback.

### Improved

- Candidate filtering: Fallback candidates now exclude `libswift*` and ignored injection-related dylib/framework names, with consistent case-insensitive handling.
- Diagnostics: Expanded Mach-O scan logs with candidate counts, file sizes, encrypted/unreadable stats, and final target selection.
- Settings clarity: Refined Advanced Settings layout and explanatory copy for better non-technical readability.
- Ads/assets: Removed built-in `Letterpress` ad entry and related localization/icon assets; refreshed marketing artwork.

### Localization

- Updated `en/zh-Hans/it/vi` strings for compatibility-fallback and settings guidance, and removed strings for deleted entries.

apps.name: TwitchAdBlock
apps.subtitle: Ad blocker for the Twitch app on iOS
apps.localizedDescription: TwitchAdBlock is an open-source tweak for the native Twitch iOS app that blocks advert break requests at the network layer, so streams play without ads and without the purple loading screen. This fork by gunnerkidBT keeps the tweak working on the latest Twitch releases (29.x-30.x) and modern iOS versions, and publishes ready-to-sideload IPAs built from the official tweak source.
apps.versionDescription:
Twitch 30.7 | TwitchAdBlock 0.1.13

**TwitchMods v0.1.13** — for Twitch iOS **30.7**

### New in v0.1.13
- **Casting & AirPlay now work with ad-blocking on.** Previously, having the ad-block proxy enabled could make casting to a Chromecast crash after a few seconds, or make AirPlay to an Apple TV show "offline." The mod now automatically steps aside while you're casting/AirPlaying, so the stream plays on the TV — and your phone goes right back to blocking ads the moment you stop. (The stream *on the TV* still shows ads — the TV fetches the video itself, so that can't be blocked — but your phone stays ad-free.)

### Everything else (v0.1.12)
- Blocks ads (live + VOD pre-rolls, feed banners, sponsor spots, the "Go Ad-Free" Turbo button)
- Keep Live Feed Playing · 7TV/BTTV/FFZ chat emotes + Reload · settings backup/restore · Diagnostics · launch screen · hide Stories

### Downloads
- **`tv.twitch-30.7-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.13.ipa`** — full app.
- **`tv.twitch-30.7-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.13-noplugins.ipa`** — app extensions removed so a free Apple ID only uses 1 App ID slot when sideloading.

Install with **AltStore / SideStore** (drag in the IPA) or **TrollStore** (tap +, pick the IPA).

Full plain-language changelog: [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/gunnerkidBT/TwitchAdBlock/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md)
